```{python}
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib_inline.backend_inline import set_matplotlib_formats

_style = Path("assets/fmrimod.mplstyle")
if not _style.exists():
    _style = Path("../assets/fmrimod.mplstyle")
plt.style.use(_style)
# Quarto's fig-dpi/fig-format setup calls IPython.display.set_matplotlib_formats,
# which IPython 9 removed, so it fails silently and figures render at 1x.
# Retina PNGs keep CSS size at figure.dpi and double the pixels.
plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 100
set_matplotlib_formats("retina")
```
